title: Add alpha release readiness report
summary: Alpha evidence bundles can be generated and validated, but there is no single local command that summarizes the repository-level blockers before a human release decision. Add a read-only readiness report that checks dirty state, identity guards, README/status drift, autonomy records, provenance, live coverage metadata, and GitHub push attribution.
expectedFailureModes: Release operators miss a known blocker because release evidence commands are scattered across docs.
The readiness command mutates state or attempts a push while checking release prerequisites.
A read-only GitHub push attribution failure is hidden instead of surfaced as a release blocker.
nextAction: Add a read-only alpha release readiness command with text and JSON output, document it in release validation docs and landing docs, and keep push attribution as a reported blocker rather than a mutating step.
